blocks.text: MILWAUKEE— Damian Lillard scored a season-high 33 points in his return to Milwaukee and the Trail Blazers won 124-114 to hand the Bucks their 12th consecutive loss in the NBA on Thursday night. The only longer skid in Bucks’ history came in March 1996, when they lost 15 straight games, according to Sportradar. That team went on to finish 25-57. Milwaukee’s 1-15 record is its worst mark ever through the first 16 games of a season. This game marked the first time Lillard had played at Milwaukee since getting waived in the summer of 2025 after two seasons with the Bucks. […]...
